<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="bbKKdsAPuEprLwe6hVAM"> <mxGraphModel dx="2287" dy="1070" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction

skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam actorStyle awesome

actor \"Médico\" as Medico

rectangle \"Sistema de Gestión Médica\" {

 usecase \"CU-M-01\nAutenticarse\" as UC01
 usecase \"CU-M-02\nConsultar turnos asignados\" as UC02
 usecase \"CU-M-03\nGestionar estado de turnos\" as UC03
 usecase \"CU-M-04\nRegistrar inasistencia\ndel paciente\" as UC04
 usecase \"CU-M-05\nCancelar turno\" as UC05
 usecase \"CU-M-06\nGestionar disponibilidad\" as UC06
 usecase \"CU-M-07\nGestionar perfil\nprofesional\" as UC07
 usecase \"CU-M-08\nRegistrar evolución\nclínica\" as UC08
 usecase \"CU-M-09\nConsultar historial\nclínico\" as UC09


 usecase \"Enviar código OTP\" as OTP
 usecase \"Validar código OTP\" as VALIDAR_OTP

 usecase \"Seleccionar turno\" as SELECT_TURNO
 usecase \"Validar transición\nde estado\" as VALIDAR_ESTADO

 usecase \"Confirmar acción\" as CONFIRMAR
 usecase \"Liberar disponibilidad\nhoraria\" as LIBERAR
}


Medico --> UC01
Medico --> UC02
Medico --> UC03
Medico --> UC04
Medico --> UC05
Medico --> UC06
Medico --> UC07
Medico --> UC08
Medico --> UC09


UC01 .> OTP : <<include>>
UC01 .> VALIDAR_OTP : <<include>>


UC03 .> SELECT_TURNO : <<include>>
UC03 .> VALIDAR_ESTADO : <<include>>


UC04 .> SELECT_TURNO : <<include>>
UC04 .> CONFIRMAR : <<include>>
UC04 .> LIBERAR : <<include>>


UC05 .> SELECT_TURNO : <<include>>
UC05 .> CONFIRMAR : <<include>>
UC05 .> LIBERAR : <<include>>


UC08 ..> UC09 : <<extend>>

@enduml",
